menu.intro: You are about to enter a space full of challenges, get ready!

0.tutorial: For this challenge, you will use the magnetometer. You will need to move your phone and have a clear space around you.
0.fun-fact-1: Leia's scenes on Tatooine in Return of the Jedi were filmed in the desert, under extreme temperatures.
0.fun-fact-2: But Carrie Fisher insisted on doing the scene where Leia strangles Jabba with her chain herself.
0.hint: When you have directed the phone correctly: 'boiling' will appear, you must move forward in that direction.

1.tutorial: For this challenge, you will use the gyroscope. You will need to tilt your phone to move through the game.
1.fun-fact-1: During the filming of the very first Star Wars, Carrie Fisher constantly got stuck in the passages
1.fun-fact-2: of the Death Star, making everyone on set laugh.
1.hint: Tilt your phone in the direction you want to go; your position is the one in the labyrinth.

2.tutorial: For this challenge, you will use the ambient light sensor. You will need to find the perfect brightness.
2.fun-fact-1: While filming the Rebel base scenes on Hoth in The Empire Strikes Back, Carrie Fisher arrived on set in Finse, Norway,
2.fun-fact-2: in a nearly polar setting, just to be with the crew, even though her own scenes were mostly filmed in a studio.
2.hint: To succeed, you need to go to a darker place.
